facts.business: Perfect-Octave Media Projects Limited is engaged in media and entertainment services, generating revenue from FCT (Free Commercial Time) income, sponsorship income, and live event income.

auditor.name: Gupta Raj & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: The ownership records of Intangible Assets (content) should be maintained in systematic manner also content should be verified and valued by expert at regular intervals.

key_risks: Ownership records of intangible assets (content) not maintained systematically
Content not verified and valued by expert at regular intervals
Trade payables subject to confirmation and reconciliation
Related party loan write-back of Rs. 2.26 crore recognized as income
Low revenue base and dependence on limited income streams
facts.related_party_note: An amount of Rs. 2.26 crore payable to a related party has been written back and recognised as income during the year, pursuant to mutual understanding as the amount is no longer payable. Loan from directors: Rs. 79.49 lakhs. Intercorporate loan: Rs. 69.54 lakhs. Secured loan of Rs. 143.00 lakhs from AU Bank secured against term deposit in the name of director Ganeshkumar Kuppan and guaranteed by him.
